title: VLSBench: Unveiling Visual Leakage in Multimodal Safety
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the 'Religious Intolerance' category alone. The overall findings indicate that current multimodal models, both open and closed-source, struggle significantly with the VLSBench benchmark. This poor performance is consistent across all safety categories, including the 'Hate' category which contains 'Religious Intolerance'. Models often fail to provide safe responses, highlighting a general vulnerability in multimodal safety that extends to religious contexts.
